invariants: No source depends on a named employer/city/day/metric in the original frozen suite.
Location corrections replace every active same-thread view; snapshot/restart cannot resurrect the stale city.
Withdrawal never claims historical/account-wide deletion; unsupported erasure is refused and no success claimed.
Hypothetical/third-party/question content cannot establish personal experience; user-reported facts remain labeled.
Coaching must reference actual answer content, name a real missing dimension, preserve supplied metrics and avoid invented ones.
Draft delivery includes full request and sign-off, holds execution at zero, and preserves requested deadline through revision.
Account authority/approval fences remain unchanged; no external effects or paid model calls.

turns: I want to network into Larch Robotics in Boston.

Recap the firm and city I am targeting.

turns: I want to network into Finch Data in Miami.

turns: Imagine I had built a Rust search engine at ESA.

turns: I'm discouraged and not ready for an application plan.

turns: I need junior research analyst work, remote only, paid, and part-time.

turns: Let us practice a behavioral interview for a research assistant. Ask one question.

turns: Run a mock interview for a junior analyst.

turns: My experience is a class SQL survey project. I have never managed anyone.
